"""One-off read-only-source census; run through run_logged + record_command.

This is a work/ script, not a project tool or a replacement scientific checker.
Example runs JSON (append explicit inner retry names to the corresponding list):
{"t02_look_table_a01": ["t02_look_table_a01"],
 "t02_look_table_b01": ["t02_look_table_b01"],
 "t02_look_table_c01": ["t02_look_table_c01"]}

The caller supplies the independently fixed plan SHA. No GPU is used. Original
failed runs remain inputs; an authenticated observed trigger takes precedence
over other observations of the SAME original proposal identity.

Optional --extensions-json contains a list of {"plan": {file, sha256},
"logged_result": {file, sha256, metrics_sha256, git_commit, exit_code}} entries.
Each successful logged plan must print CENSUS_EXTENSION_PLAN_JSON with the
exact extension plan. Extensions add observations of original pairs only.
"""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from src.tools import merge_pair_v2 as merge
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result, sha_file
from src.envs import pair_v2_fixed_labels as labels

ROOT = merge.ROOT.resolve()
TRIGGER = "triggered_non_anchor_divergent"
COMPLETE = "completed_without_this_trigger"
UNKNOWN = "unknown_timeout_or_other_error"
REF_KEYS = ("file", "sha256", "metrics_sha256", "git_commit", "exit_code")
AUDITED = {}


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def checked_path(reference, within=None):
    path = merge.reference_path(reference, root=ROOT, within=within)
    if "bytes" in reference:
        require(type(reference["bytes"]) is int and path.stat().st_size == reference["bytes"],
                "Artifact byte length differs: " + str(path))
    return path


def read_ref(reference, within=None):
    return json.loads(checked_path(reference, within).read_text())


def same_ref(actual, expected):
    require(isinstance(actual, dict) and isinstance(expected, dict), "Missing original reference")
    for key in REF_KEYS:
        if key in expected:
            require(actual.get(key) == expected[key], "Original reference differs: " + key)


def audit(reference_or_file):
    file = reference_or_file if isinstance(reference_or_file, str) else reference_or_file["file"]
    if file not in AUDITED:
        data, ref = audited_result(ROOT / file)
        require(bool(data["_meta"].get("end")), "Run has no recorded end: " + file)
        AUDITED[file] = (data, ref)
    data, ref = AUDITED[file]
    if isinstance(reference_or_file, dict):
        same_ref(ref, reference_or_file)
    return data, ref


def authenticate_entry(entry):
    """Recheck the immutable original publication, not a new acceptance test."""
    checkpoint, _ = audit(entry["checkpoint"])
    source, source_ref = audit(entry["source"])
    require(checkpoint["_meta"]["exit_code"] == 0 and checkpoint["metrics"]["errors"] == [],
            "Inventory checkpoint is not an ended positive publication")
    matches = [r for r in checkpoint["metrics"]["candidate_pairs"]
               if r.get("pair_reference") == entry["pair_reference"]]
    require(len(matches) == 1, "Inventory pair not uniquely published")
    published = matches[0]
    pair = read_ref(entry["pair_reference"], ROOT / "data/world_pairs/v2")
    identity = merge.proposal_identity(pair)
    require(identity == entry["proposal_identity"] == published["proposal_identity"]
            == published["independent_verification"]["proposal_identity"], "Proposal identity mismatch")
    require(published["independent_verification"]["validity"]["acceptance_passed"] is True,
            "Inventory lacks original independent construction acceptance")
    for key in ("pair_id", "scene", "kind", "target_w0", "target_w1"):
        require(pair[key] == entry[key] == published[key], "Published identity differs: " + key)
    require(entry["kind"] in ("look_flip", "look_stay") and entry["field_of_view"] == 60
            and source["config"].get("field_of_view") == 60, "Wrong current census population")
    require(entry["source_file"] == source_ref["file"] == published["source_file"]
            and published["source_sha256"] == source_ref["sha256"]
            and published["source_metrics_sha256"] == source_ref["metrics_sha256"], "Source changed")
    declared = [r for r in checkpoint["sources"] if r.get("file") == source_ref["file"]]
    require(len(declared) == 1, "Checkpoint source manifest missing or duplicated")
    same_ref(declared[0], source_ref)
    expected = labels.pair_fields(pair["pair_id"], pair["identities"]["candidate_names"])
    labels.validate_fields(source["config"])
    for value in (pair, published["independent_verification"]["fixed_labels_verified"]):
        require(all(value.get(k) == v for k, v in expected.items()), "Original fixed-label proof changed")
    require(entry["fixed_label_version"] == labels.VERSION
            and entry["candidate_label_assignment"] == expected["candidate_label_assignment"],
            "Inventory fixed-label assignment changed")
    return pair


def authenticate_package(reference, entry, original_pair):
    package = read_ref(reference)
    for key in ("pair_id", "scene", "kind"):
        require(package.get(key) == entry[key], "Export package identity differs: " + key)
    require(package["row"] == original_pair, "Export package changed original pair bytes/content")
    provenance = package["source_provenance"]
    for key, expected in (("container", entry["checkpoint"]), ("scene", entry["source"]),
                          ("pair", entry["pair_reference"])):
        same_ref(provenance[key], expected)
        checked_path(provenance[key])
    checked_path(provenance["journal"])
    for reference in package["sources"]:
        audit(reference)
    source, _ = audit(entry["source"])
    require(package["source_config"] == source["config"], "Package source configuration changed")
    require(package["independent_verification"]["proposal_identity"] == entry["proposal_identity"]
            and package["independent_verification"]["validity"]["acceptance_passed"] is True,
            "Package independent proposal proof differs")
    verified = labels.validate_table_package(package)
    require(verified["t01_t02_assignment_equal"] is True
            and package.get("fixed_label_verification") == verified, "Package fixed labels disagree")
    for world in package["worlds"]:
        checked_path(world["reference"])
    return package


def row_observation(row, entry, original_pair, result_reference):
    """Keep authentication failures as unknown, without discarding original rows."""
    observation = {"result": result_reference, "row": row, "classification": UNKNOWN,
                   "authentication_errors": [], "full_T02_acceptance": None,
                   "cache_or_training_authorized": False}
    try:
        for key in ("pair_id", "scene", "kind"):
            require(row.get(key) == entry[key], "Result row identity mismatch: " + key)
        package = authenticate_package(row["source_package"], entry, original_pair)
        report = read_ref(row["report_reference"])
        # The parent adds source/worker identities and may append cleanup errors
        # AFTER pair_report.json is written; compare the immutable worker fields.
        for key, value in report.items():
            if key == "cleanup_errors":
                require(isinstance(row.get(key), list) and row[key][:len(value)] == value,
                        "Parent cleanup no longer preserves the worker report")
            else:
                require(row.get(key) == value, "Original worker report differs: " + key)
        raw_refs = [report[k] for k in ("raw_index", "raw_incremental_index") if report.get(k)]
        require(bool(raw_refs), "No authenticated original native index")
        for reference in raw_refs:
            checked_path(reference)
        observation["authenticated_package_proposal_identity"] = package["independent_verification"]["proposal_identity"]
        observation["worker_report"] = report
        triggered = ("non_anchor_divergent" in report.get("rejection_reasons", [])
                     and report.get("error") == {"type": "ValueError", "message": "non_anchor_divergent"})
        if triggered:
            # Any measured trigger is decisive even if a later cleanup/index
            # failure prevented a full table. Such failures stay in the row.
            observation["classification"] = TRIGGER
            return observation
        if report.get("table_complete") is not True or report.get("native_evidence_verified") is not True:
            observation["unknown_reason"] = "No complete independently checked export table"
            return observation
        require(report.get("status") in ("exported", "rejected") and report.get("error") is None
                and row.get("cleanup_errors") == [] and not report.get("raw_index_error"),
                "Completed-table status/cleanup is not trustworthy")
        detail = read_ref(report["detail"])
        require(detail.get("table_complete") is True and detail["native_checks"].get("passed") is True
                and detail["table_manifest"] == report["table_manifest"]
                and detail["pair_checks"]["passed"] == report["pair_checks_passed"]
                and detail["pair_checks"]["reasons"] == report["rejection_reasons"],
                "Original native/checks detail differs")
        table_ref = detail["table_manifest"]
        table_path = checked_path(table_ref)
        table = json.loads(table_path.read_text())
        for key in ("pair_id", "scene", "kind"):
            require(table[key] == entry[key], "Table identity differs: " + key)
        require(table["depth"] == 4 and table["source"]["field_of_view"] == 60
                and table["source"]["t01"] == package["source_provenance"], "Table D4/camera/source differs")
        for reference in table["files"]:
            checked_path({**reference, "file": str(table_path.parent / reference["file"])}, table_path.parent)
        measurement = report["export_measurements"]
        require(measurement == detail["export_measurements"] == table["export_measurements"]
                and measurement["state_count"] == len(table["states"])
                and measurement["non_anchor_divergent_states"] == 0,
                "Complete Look table measurement differs")
        observation.update(classification=COMPLETE, pair_checks_passed=report["pair_checks_passed"],
                           other_pair_rejection_reasons=report["rejection_reasons"], detail_reference=report["detail"])
    except Exception as error:
        observation["authentication_errors"].append(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
    return observation


def options(arguments, key):
    return [arguments[index + 1] for index, value in enumerate(arguments[:-1]) if value == key]


def validate_export_run(data, group, name):
    cfg, metrics, meta = data["config"], data["metrics"], data["_meta"]
    argv = merge.producer_arguments(meta["command"], "src.tools.t02_export")
    require(meta["name"] == cfg["name"] == name and options(argv, "--name") == [name], "Run name mismatch")
    require(metrics["kind"] == "t02_table_export" and cfg["gpus"] == 1 and cfg["resolution"] == 255
            and cfg["depth"] == 4, "Not the declared single-GPU D4 exporter")
    require(cfg["pair_id"] == group["pair_ids"] == options(argv, "--pair-id"), "Retry changed the pair list/order")
    require(len(options(argv, "--source")) == 1 and (ROOT / cfg["source"]).resolve() == (ROOT / group["source"]).resolve()
            == (ROOT / options(argv, "--source")[0]).resolve(), "Retry changed source checkpoint")
    require(cfg.get("pair_file") is None and not options(argv, "--pair-file"), "Unexpected alternative pair file")
    for key in ("timeout_seconds", "pair_timeout_seconds", "gate_timeout_seconds"):
        flag = "--" + key.replace("_", "-")
        values = options(argv, flag)
        # The unchanged exporter defaults only its gate timeout to 180 seconds.
        actual = 180 if key == "gate_timeout_seconds" and not values else float(values[0]) if len(values) == 1 else None
        require(cfg[key] == group[key] == actual, "Retry changed deadline: " + key)
    ids = [r["pair_id"] for r in metrics["pairs"]]
    unstarted = metrics["unstarted_pair_ids"]
    require(len(ids) == len(set(ids)) and len(unstarted) == len(set(unstarted))
            and set(ids).isdisjoint(unstarted) and set(ids) | set(unstarted) == set(group["pair_ids"]),
            "Run does not partition the exact scheduled pair inventory")
    if metrics.get("gate") is not None:
        gate, _ = audit(metrics["gate"])
        if metrics["pairs"]:
            from src.tools.t02_export import gate_runtime
            gate_runtime(gate, cfg, cfg["node"], Path(cfg["scratch_directory"]) / "unity_logs")
    else:
        require(not metrics["pairs"], "Pair results exist without an authenticated gate")


def read_extensions(path, base_plan):
    """Authenticate explicitly recorded additional runs, not a new population."""
    if path is None:
        return [], [], None
    content = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    require(isinstance(content, list) and content, "Extensions must be an explicit nonempty reference list")
    groups, references = [], []
    for item in content:
        require(isinstance(item, dict) and set(item) == {"plan", "logged_result"},
                "Each extension requires its original plan and logged result references")
        plan_ref, result_ref = item["plan"], item["logged_result"]
        require(isinstance(plan_ref, dict) and set(plan_ref) == {"file", "sha256"}
                and isinstance(result_ref, dict) and all(key in result_ref for key in REF_KEYS),
                "Freeze the extension plan SHA and complete logged result identity")
        extension = read_ref(plan_ref, ROOT / "logs/review")
        data, actual_ref = audit(result_ref)
        meta = data["_meta"]
        arguments = merge.producer_arguments(meta["command"], "src.tools.record_command")
        require(meta["exit_code"] == 0 and data["metrics"]["command_exit_code"] == 0
                and data.get("error") is None and arguments[:3] == ["--name", meta["name"], "--"]
                and arguments[3:] == data["config"]["command"],
                "Extension plan was not successfully recorded by its exact original wrapper")
        log = (ROOT / meta["log_path"]).resolve()
        require(log.is_relative_to(ROOT / "logs/runs"), "Extension log escaped original run directory")
        marker = "CENSUS_EXTENSION_PLAN_JSON: "
        printed = [json.loads(line[len(marker):]) for line in log.read_text().splitlines()
                   if line.startswith(marker)]
        require(printed == [extension], "Extension file differs from its unique original logged plan")
        require(extension.get("base_plan") == base_plan,
                "Extension does not bind the unchanged original fixed17 plan")
        extra = extension.get("groups")
        require(isinstance(extra, list) and extra, "Extension has no explicit export group")
        groups.extend(extra)
        references.append({"plan": plan_ref, "logged_result": actual_ref,
                           "log": {"file": str(log.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha_file(log)}})
    return groups, references, {"file": str(path), "sha256": sha_file(path), "content": content}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--name", default="diag_look_table_census_01")
    parser.add_argument("--plan", default="logs/review/diag_look_census_plan_01/census_plan.json")
    parser.add_argument("--plan-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--runs-json", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--extensions-json", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(re.fullmatch(r"diag_look_table_census_[A-Za-z0-9_]+", args.name), "Use an unused diagnostic name")
    require(os.environ.get("CVPR_RUN_NAME") == args.name, "Set CVPR_RUN_NAME; run through the authorized wrapper")
    plan_ref = {"file": args.plan, "sha256": args.plan_sha256}
    plan = read_ref(plan_ref)
    inventory = read_ref(plan["inventory"])
    current = inventory["current_standard"]
    entries = current["pairs"]
    require(plan["unique_denominator"] == current["unique_count"] == len(entries) == 17,
            "Pinned census denominator differs from the authenticated inventory")
    by_identity = {e["proposal_identity"]: e for e in entries}
    require(len(by_identity) == 17 and current["field_of_view"] == 60
            and current["fixed_label_version"] == labels.VERSION, "Wrong unique population")
    by_pair_ref = {(e["pair_reference"]["file"], e["pair_reference"]["sha256"]): e for e in entries}
    original_pairs = {e["proposal_identity"]: authenticate_entry(e) for e in entries}
    observations = {identity: [] for identity in by_identity}
    old = plan["existing_conclusive_failure"]
    require(old["entry"] == by_identity[old["entry"]["proposal_identity"]], "Old failure changed inventory representative")
    covered = [old["entry"]["proposal_identity"]]
    groups = list(plan["groups"])
    group_entries = {}
    for group in groups:
        require(len(group["pair_ids"]) == len(group["pair_references"]), "Plan IDs/references length differs")
        chosen = []
        for pair_id, ref in zip(group["pair_ids"], group["pair_references"]):
            entry = by_pair_ref[(ref["file"], ref["sha256"])]
            require(entry["pair_id"] == pair_id and entry["checkpoint"]["file"] == group["source"], "Plan pair/source mismatch")
            covered.append(entry["proposal_identity"])
            chosen.append(entry)
        require(group["inner_name"] not in group_entries, "Duplicate plan group")
        group_entries[group["inner_name"]] = chosen
    require(len(covered) == 17 and set(covered) == set(by_identity), "Plan has duplicate or missing proposals")
    # Check the original population first. Additional observations never add to
    # covered, replace a base group, or remove the original timeout/failure run.
    extensions, extension_refs, extensions_list = read_extensions(args.extensions_json, plan_ref)
    for group in extensions:
        require(group.get("gpus") == 1 and group["inner_name"] not in group_entries,
                "Extension must be a distinct original single-GPU run group")
        require(group["pair_ids"] and len(group["pair_ids"]) == len(group["pair_references"])
                and len(group["pair_ids"]) == len(set(group["pair_ids"])),
                "Extension pair IDs/references missing or duplicated")
        chosen = []
        for pair_id, ref in zip(group["pair_ids"], group["pair_references"]):
            entry = by_pair_ref[(ref["file"], ref["sha256"])]
            require(ref == entry["pair_reference"] and entry["pair_id"] == pair_id
                    and entry["checkpoint"]["file"] == group["source"],
                    "Extension changed an original pair reference/source or added to the population")
            chosen.append(entry)
        group_entries[group["inner_name"]] = chosen
        groups.append(group)
    runs_body = args.runs_json.read_bytes()
    runs = json.loads(runs_body)
    require(set(runs) == set(group_entries), "Run lists must explicitly cover every original and extension group")
    require(all(isinstance(values, list) for values in runs.values()), "Each run group must be an explicit list")
    all_names = [name for values in runs.values() for name in values]
    require(len(all_names) == len(set(all_names)), "A run was assigned more than once")
    for group in groups:
        names = runs[group["inner_name"]]
        require(isinstance(names, list) and names and names[0] == group["inner_name"]
                and all(isinstance(n, str) and re.fullmatch(r"t02_[A-Za-z0-9_]+", n) for n in names),
                "Keep each original run first; append explicit inner retry names")
    run_records = []
    # Original failure is retained, authenticated, and never rerendered here.
    old_data, old_ref = audit(old["export_result"])
    old_rows = [r for r in old_data["metrics"]["exports"] if r.get("pair_id") == old["entry"]["pair_id"]]
    require(len(old_rows) == 1 and old_rows[0] == old["report"], "Pinned original failure row changed")
    identity = old["entry"]["proposal_identity"]
    observations[identity].append(row_observation(old_rows[0], old["entry"], original_pairs[identity], old_ref))
    run_records.append({"reference": old_ref, "reused_original_failure": True,
                        "status": old_data["metrics"].get("status"), "errors": old_data["metrics"].get("errors"),
                        "cleanup_errors": old_data["metrics"].get("cleanup_errors")})
    for group in groups:
        for name in runs[group["inner_name"]]:
            file = f"results/{name}.json"
            record = {"file": file, "group": group["inner_name"], "authentication_error": None}
            run_records.append(record)
            try:
                data, reference = audit(file)
                record.update(reference=reference, original_config=data["config"], original_metrics=data["metrics"])
                validate_export_run(data, group, name)
                rows = {r["pair_id"]: r for r in data["metrics"]["pairs"]}
                for entry in group_entries[group["inner_name"]]:
                    identity = entry["proposal_identity"]
                    if entry["pair_id"] in rows:
                        observation = row_observation(rows[entry["pair_id"]], entry, original_pairs[identity], reference)
                    else:
                        observation = {"result": reference, "classification": UNKNOWN,
                                       "unknown_reason": "Explicitly unstarted in original exporter",
                                       "original_run_status": data["metrics"].get("status"),
                                       "original_run_errors": data["metrics"].get("errors")}
                    observations[identity].append(observation)
            except Exception as error:
                record["authentication_error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
                for entry in group_entries[group["inner_name"]]:
                    observations[entry["proposal_identity"]].append({"file": file, "classification": UNKNOWN,
                        "unknown_reason": record["authentication_error"]})
    rows = []
    for entry in entries:
        seen = observations[entry["proposal_identity"]]
        kinds = {r["classification"] for r in seen}
        classification = TRIGGER if TRIGGER in kinds else COMPLETE if COMPLETE in kinds else UNKNOWN
        rows.append({"entry": entry, "classification": classification, "observations": seen,
                     "conflicting_trigger_and_complete_observations": TRIGGER in kinds and COMPLETE in kinds})
    counts = dict(Counter(r["classification"] for r in rows))
    counts = {key: counts.get(key, 0) for key in (TRIGGER, COMPLETE, UNKNOWN)}
    report = {"created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "scope": plan["scope"], "plan": plan_ref, "inventory": plan["inventory"],
        "extensions": extension_refs, "extensions_list": extensions_list,
        "runs_list": {"file": str(args.runs_json), "sha256": sha_file(args.runs_json), "content": runs},
        "population_scope": "Original frozen17 plan/inventory snapshot only; later independently accepted G01 Look pairs belong to a separate batch and are not counted here.",
        "denominator": 17, "counts": counts, "triggered_fraction_of_frozen_inventory": counts[TRIGGER] / 17,
        "fraction_interpretation": "Observed any-trigger fraction of the fixed 17; unknowns remain in denominator, not passes.",
        "historical_not_current": {"unique_count": inventory["historical_not_current"]["unique_count"],
                                   "scope": inventory["historical_not_current"]["scope"]},
        "pairs": rows, "runs": run_records, "thresholds_changed": False, "source_artifacts_modified": False,
        "full_T02_acceptance": None, "cache_or_training_authorized": False,
        "classification_notes": ["Triggered means an authenticated existing worker reported the unchanged non_anchor_divergent rejection.",
            "Completed-without-trigger requires a complete original native-verified table; other pair-check rejection remains explicit.",
            "Error/timeout/black/unstarted/missing or unauthenticated evidence is unknown, never a pass.",
            "No new rendering or scientific acceptance check was performed; original audited checks and artifact bytes are preserved."]}
    folder = ROOT / "logs/review" / args.name
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    with (folder / "report.json").open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    lines = ["# Look full-view diagnostic census", "", report["scope"], "",
        f"Original frozen batch: 17 unique 60-degree, fixed-label Look proposals. Triggered: {counts[TRIGGER]}; "
        f"complete without this trigger: {counts[COMPLETE]}; unknown: {counts[UNKNOWN]}.", "",
        report["population_scope"], "",
        "Unknowns remain in the denominator and are not counted as passes. Historical nonfixed-label pairs are excluded. "
        "This report does not authorize cache use or training, and does not imply complete T02 acceptance.", "",
        "| Pair | Outcome | Original runs / evidence status |", "|---|---|---|"]
    for row in rows:
        detail = "; ".join((o.get("result", {}).get("file") or o.get("file", "unknown")) + ": " +
                           o["classification"] + (" (" + o["unknown_reason"] + ")" if o.get("unknown_reason") else "")
                           for o in row["observations"])
        lines.append("| " + row["entry"]["pair_id"] + " | " + row["classification"] + " | "
                     + detail.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ") + " |")
    lines += ["", "Full original references, errors, cleanup status, authenticated package associations and retry observations are in report.json."]
    with (folder / "report.md").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    with (ROOT / "STATUS.md").open("a") as stream:
        stream.write(f"\n\nLook D4 census (`{args.name}`): original frozen batch with unique denominator 17; "
            f"observed non_anchor_divergent {counts[TRIGGER]}/17; complete without that trigger {counts[COMPLETE]}; "
            f"unknown {counts[UNKNOWN]} (timeouts/errors/unstarted/unauthenticated evidence are not passes). "
            "The original failure and all explicitly listed retries are preserved; any authenticated trigger takes precedence per proposal. "
            "Later independently accepted G01 Look pairs remain a separate batch outside this frozen inventory. "
            f"Historical nonfixed-label pairs remain separate. [Report](logs/review/{args.name}/report.md). "
            "No threshold changed; no cache/training authorization or full T02 acceptance is implied.\n")
    print("LOOK_TABLE_CENSUS_SUMMARY: " + json.dumps({"name": args.name, "denominator": 17, "counts": counts,
        "extensions": extension_refs,
        "report": {"file": str((folder / "report.json").relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha_file(folder / "report.json")},
        "markdown": {"file": str((folder / "report.md").relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha_file(folder / "report.md")}},
        sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
